items.name: Grizz League IV 2023
items.information: This competition only has Fewest Move! If you would like more traditionnal events, please consider registering to another competition. Please be especially familiar with [article E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) of the regulations.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till höstsäsongen av Jönköpingsligan 2023! Mer information om Jönköpingsligan upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn.
